// Task #4380: Why this file exists: bunup.config.ts sets `dts: false` (bunup's dts pass
fails on pre-existing strict errors in this repo), and nothing replaced it —
so the published tarball contained ZERO .d.ts files while package.json
resolved to an implicit `any` (TS7016), which silently disabled the
compile-time guards downstream (see Task #4375 / review finding Y4).
`--noCheck` (TS >= 5.6) emits declarations without type-checking, which is
what we want here: the emitted .d.ts describe the real code, and the
pre-existing type errors in unrelated modules no longer block publishing.
What `--noCheck` does NOT buy: type safety of new code. That is gated
separately by `npm run typecheck:dts` (no `--noCheck`), which must report
ZERO errors under src/env/task/backend/ — the pre-existing errors live in
sqlite-task-store row mapping, batch-archive/update tools) and are
documented in the Task #4380 report rather than silently absorbed here.
